# analysis-route fixtures (A1300 E13, PRD analysis-skills-nonfable-route, AC 2)

Everything here comes from j0yen/dotfiles base commit `f9066716b260e6ba14b8a7cca8ee27b35954555d` and was written on 2026-11-18 by `gen-base-fixtures.sh` (this directory). No byte was written or edited by hand.

- Vendored base files, each checked against its full sha256 when written and again by every test that reads it (a missing or mismatched file fails the test; it never skips):
  - `f9066716-skill-route-resolve.py` = `.local/lib/skill-route-resolve.py`, sha256 `088dd2ec89627541dda79ff08bc03d72b99d2a609a24aa62629fa487cb46d055`
  - `f9066716-policy.json` = `.config/skill-routing/policy.json`, sha256 `a5b27682b5787d4b12edc77e0e228e26d2cb2255d5c429a0345be859836bd388`
  - `f9066716-analysis-page-gate.sh` = `.claude/hooks/analysis-page-gate.sh`, sha256 `f11751ecf35a1d9b5ba106aa099a48ccb626bfc10d625b933eb3f5c8448d8a6a` (AC 1 runs admit row A1 on it, which must exit 2; it is never installed or wired)
- `base-route-table.json` is the full skill-routing resolution table of those vendored bytes, generated by the unchanged FFDR generator `tests/fixtures/ffdr/gen-route-table.py`: for every governed skill of the base policy, its baseline, every class and every escalation reason with valid evidence (`ledger:A1300`), the `max_exception` class with a recorded exception carrying a ledger reference, then every review reason on the skill's first model-routed row (61 rows). Each row keeps the request, the resolver's exit code and its output.
- Command, from the repository root (it writes only this directory):

      bash tests/fixtures/analysis-route/gen-base-fixtures.sh

  which runs, after the three `git show f9066716b260e6ba14b8a7cca8ee27b35954555d:<path>` extractions and their digest checks:

      python3 -I tests/fixtures/ffdr/gen-route-table.py --policy tests/fixtures/analysis-route/f9066716-policy.json \
        --resolver tests/fixtures/analysis-route/f9066716-skill-route-resolve.py \
        --source "j0yen/dotfiles f9066716b260e6ba14b8a7cca8ee27b35954555d" >tests/fixtures/analysis-route/base-route-table.json

- `tests/analysis-route_ac02_base_table.test.sh` regenerates the table from the vendored files and requires it byte-identical to this one, then requires the head table (same generator on the head policy and resolver) equal to it row for row. `tests/fixtures/ffdr/` and `tests/ffdr-route-table.test.sh` are not changed by this PRD.
- The fixtures belong to this base commit. A different base needs new fixtures generated the same way.
